entries.speaker: Cracks in the Enemy's Defense
entries.en: Gun attacks can't perform critical hits, however, they[n]will weaken the enemy's defense. This makes critical[n]hits more likely with other attacks.

entries.speaker: Cracks in the Enemy's Defense
entries.en: The higher your attack power, the more likely you[n]will crack your foe's defense. Following a critical hit,[n]the enemy's defense will return to normal.
